offers_products.reason: Makes and sells packaged shelf-stable and frozen foods under 50+ brands like Green Giant, Crisco, Ortega, Cream of Wheat.

offers_services.reason: Only sells branded packaged food; no services offered as a main offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Branded foods chosen by household shoppers at grocery stores; website speaks to families and consumers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to grocery retailers, mass merchants, club stores and foodservice customers who buy for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat orders of pantry staples and food by retailers and households, such as canned vegetables, spices and oils.

cyclical_demand.reason: Packaged groceries are staples; demand holds up in recessions, with possible trade-down to private label.

big_ticket.reason: Low-priced, frequently purchased grocery items such as canned goods, spices and syrup.

people_delivered.reason: Value is in manufactured branded food products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Ultimate buyers are households; retailers are large but the consumer brand model points to no.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates manufacturing plants and distribution facilities for food production, needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Large_customers is borderline because major grocery chains and Walmart are big buyers, but consumers are the end market.
